Container.Name: unraid-runner-manager
Container.Overview: Web app for creating and deleting self-hosted GitHub Actions runners (myoung34/github-runner) on Unraid. Multi-user: an admin creates accounts, each user only sees their own runners. Runners are created with restart=always so they come back after a reboot. Requires the Docker socket.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required. Used to create, inspect and remove runner containers.

Config.Name: Runner data root
Config.Description: Folder that holds one sub-folder per runner. Deleting a runner deletes its folder here.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: SQLite database with user accounts and sessions.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the first admin account. Only used when no users exist yet. At least 10 characters.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Username for the first admin account. Lowercase letters and digits.

Config.Name: Unraid hostname
Config.Description: Passed to runners as HOST_HOSTNAME and shown in the UI.

Config.Name: Image update interval
Config.Description: How often to pull the runner image and recreate outdated runners. Runners busy with a job are retried every 10 minutes. Set to 0 to disable.

Config.Name: Runner data host path override
Config.Description: Host path of the runner data root. Leave empty to detect it from the /runners mount automatically.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set to true when the app is served over HTTPS (reverse proxy).
